user.title: Set up Haushaltsbuch
user.description: Adds the Haushaltsbuch panel to the sidebar. Every user keeps their own entries there.

send_contract_reminders.name: Send contract reminders
send_contract_reminders.description: Fires the event haushaltsbuch_kuendigungsfrist for every contract whose cancel-by date is 30, 7 or 1 day(s) away. Runs automatically every day at 9:00.

all.name: All upcoming
all.description: Fire for every contract that can be cancelled within the next 60 days, e.g. to test an automation.

add_expense.name: Add expense
add_expense.description: Records money spent from a budget (e.g. groceries). The rest of the budget for this month gets smaller; the forecast only counts what is left. Returns the budget, what was spent and what is left.

budget.name: Budget
budget.description: Name of the budget, e.g. Groceries. Can be left out if you only have one budget.

date.name: Date
date.description: When you spent it. Leave out for today.
